The tune is similar to games like: animal crossing, stardew valley, magicians quest, fantasy life, wandering willows, rune factory, shepherds crossing, castaway paradise, harvest moon, viva pinata, happy street and more of that genre. Suitable for games, animations, and children related productions.

tracks.title: Sunny Island Pirates
tracks.desc: This track is pure tropical bliss. A real audio adventure full of fun, storytelling and ethnic island spirit. It has motifs from pirate and adventure songs packed in a colorful and an uplifting theme. It feels like a glimpse into a picturesque island full of coconut trees, perfect beaches, and lush green forests. Featuring a marimba, a steel drum, various percussion, piccolo flute, an accordion and a harpsichord. Suitable for games, animations, and travel videos.

tracks.title: Sunny Island Adventure
tracks.desc: A funny, bubbly and summery tune with a good sense of humor, jumpy melody and good vibes. Has a strong tropical feeling to it. Picture a small colorful island with lush coconut palm trees, clean yellow sand and colorful cartoon animals walking around.
